super_drag_mirror.name: Super Drag Looking Glass
super_drag_mirror.description: Full-length camera mirror and a working wardrobe for the player's actual costume. Previous/Next selects Latex Cathedral, Chrome Orchid, Holographic Fan or Pearl Rococo; Walk Dress restores the progression garment. Saves appearance separately from earned trophies. Head-centred monoscopic reflection in XR.
interactions: Press Previous or Next to wear an outfit
Press Walk Dress to restore the earned garment
super_drag_mirror.qfep_connection: A chosen appearance is composed over an inferred torso and tracked head/hands; looking, dressing and bodily collision remain distinct operations.
